_doc: Hub levels and hub buildings. [money] Parts are salvaged while scooping metal, plastic and glass junk (per compartment unit of that junk type; all three now give Parts). Costs: cubes + parts. Scooped parts are finite in a district (junk runs out; the recycler and Haggle make more), so level 4-5 and Air Scrubbers ask only for cubes plus what a district reliably yields; cubes keep coming from the garden stipend (hex_levels.json). [M3-19] Base levels cost cubes only, at the accepted proposal's prices (700, 1,100, 1,400, 1,800), and no longer raise what a bale sells for: cube income is Lumi's own pace, with few multipliers (design spec section 14). materials.per_unit is 0: levels[].requires: workbench conditions that must all hold before the level can be built (level 2 waits for the Bot Bay, as the accepted proposal has it). waste holds no Parts by the unit; Parts come from buried parts and pieces worth stripping (robots.json salvage).
